language.description: Set user interface language code (e.g., en, de, fr).

max_connections_to_host.description: Maximum number of concurrent connection to a given host.

retries.description: Number of retries for failed requests.

unrestartable_receive_timeout.description: Timeout on non restartable connections in seconds.

timeout_when_trying_multiple_addresses.description: Timeout for connection when trying multiple addresses or when resuming a keepalive connection.

bind_address.description: Use a specific local IP address or interface name.

bind_address_ipv6.description: Use a specific local IPv6 address or interface name.

format_cache_size.description: Number of formatted document pages cached.

image_cache_size.description: Cache memory in bytes for images.

font_cache_size.description: Cache memory in bytes for fonts.

aggressive_cache.description: Always cache everything regardless of server's caching recommendations.

address_preference.description: 0 - use system default, 1 - prefer IPv4, 2 - prefer IPv6, 3 - use only IPv4, 4 - use only IPv6.

http_proxy.description: Host and port number of the HTTP proxy.

ftp_proxy.description: Host and port number of the FTP proxy.

https_proxy.description: Host and port number of the HTTPS proxy.

socks_proxy.description: Userid, host and port of Socks4a proxy.

no_proxy_domains.description: No proxy for specified domains, comma-separated.

only_proxies.description: Causes that Links won't initiate any non-proxy connection.

ssl_certificates.description: 0 - ignore invalid certificate, 1 - warn on invalid certificate, 2 - reject invalid certificate.

ssl_builtin_certificates.description: Use built-in certificates instead of system certificates.

ssl_client_cert_key.description: Name of the PEM encoded file with the user private key for client certificate authentication.

ssl_client_cert_crt.description: Name of the PEM encoded file with the user certificate for client certificate authentication.

ssl_client_cert_password.description: Password for the user private key for client certificate authentication.

http_bugs_allow_blacklist.description: Defaults to using list of servers that have broken HTTP/1.1 support.

http_bugs_bug_no_accept_charset.description: Do not send Accept-Charset field of HTTP header.

http_bugs_no_compression.description: Causes that links won't advertise HTTP compression support.

http_fake_firefox.description: Fake that the browser is Firefox in the HTTP header.

http_do_not_track.description: Send "do not track" request in the HTTP header.

http_referer.description: 0 - do not send referer, 1 - send requested URL, 2 - send fake referer, 3 - send real referer, 4 - send real referer only to same server.

http_extra_header.description: Extra string added to HTTP header.

ftp_use_passive.description: Use ftp PASV command to bypass firewalls.

ftp_use_erpt_epsv.description: Use EPRT and EPSV commands instead of PORT and PASV.

ftp_set_iptos.description: Set IP Type-of-service to high throughput on ftp connections.

menu_font_size.description: Size of font in menu. 0 for default.

menu_background_color.description: Set menu background color in graphics mode (hex RRGGBB).

menu_foreground_color.description: Set menu foreground color in graphics mode (hex RRGGBB).

scroll_bar_area_color.description: Set color of scroll bar area (hex RRGGBB).

scroll_bar_bar_color.description: Set color of scroll bar (hex RRGGBB).

scroll_bar_frame_color.description: Set color of scroll bar frame (hex RRGGBB).

max_cookie_age.description: Maximum cookie age in days. 0 - unlimited.

overwrite_instead_of_scroll.description: Overwrite the screen instead of scrolling it.

font_monospaced_bold.description: Font file for monospaced bold text.

font_italic_bold.description: Font file for italic bold text.

font_monospaced_italic.description: Font file for monospaced italic text.

font_monospaced_italic_bold.description: Font file for monospaced italic bold text.

html_assume_codepage.description: Use the given codepage when the webpage did not specify its codepage.

html_hard_assume.description: Use always character set from html-assume-codepage no matter what server sent.

html_images.description: Display links to unnamed images as [IMG].

html_image_names.description: Display filename of an image instead of [IMG].

html_bare_image_autoscale.description: Autoscale images displayed in full screen.

html_table_order.description: 0 - walk through table by rows, 1 - by columns.

html_auto_refresh.description: Process refresh to other page (1), or display link to that page (0).

html_target_in_new_window.description: Allow opening new windows from html.

html_margin.description: Margin in text mode (number of spaces).

html_user_font_size.description: Size of font on pages in graphics mode.

html_ignore_document_color.description: Ignore colors specified in html document in text mode.

html_g_text_color.description: Text color in graphics mode (hex RRGGBB).

html_g_link_color.description: Link color in graphics mode (hex RRGGBB).

html_g_background_color.description: Background color in graphics mode (hex RRGGBB).

html_g_ignore_document_color.description: Ignore colors specified in html document in graphics mode.
